name: MEITEC Group Holdings Inc.
summary: MEITEC Group Holdings Inc. engages in the engineering solution business in Japan. It operates through Engineering Solutions Business; Engineer introduction business; and Other segments. The company offers temporary staffing and job placement services for engineers. It also provides temporary staffing to cover design assistance, as well as various types of office work, including paperwork and reception; supply of senior age temporary engineering staff; engineer placement business service for manufacturing; and office services, as well as employs the disabled persons.
